metadata.name: Keel
metadata.summary: Deploys each new image to the services you turn auto-deploy on for.

releases.name: keel
releases.values:
image:
  # Pinned by digest; a tag alone can move. Always would hit the
  # registry on every restart.
  repository: ghcr.io/keel-hq/keel
  tag: 0.22.4@sha256:09872633675df8da591fd2c2a7a37fbe8f08e19f9972c8f64a4c1e473876ac05
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
helmProvider:
  # Workload annotations only. The Helm provider rewrites release
  # values, which conflicts with whoever owns the release.
  enabled: false
polling:
  # For workloads annotated keel.sh/trigger: poll, such as those on
  # public registries that send no webhook.
  enabled: true
  # Fewer registry requests than the chart's 1m; a workload sets
  # keel.sh/pollSchedule to poll faster.
  defaultSchedule: "@every 5m"
service:
  # Builder posts to http://keel.keel.svc:9300/v1/webhooks/native. The
  # chart's LoadBalancer would publish an unauthenticated webhook.
  enabled: true
  type: ClusterIP
  externalPort: 9300
rbac:
  clusterRole:
    # The chart's rules minus configmaps and pods/portforward, unused
    # with the Helm provider off.
    rules:
      - apiGroups: [""]
        resources: [namespaces, nodes]
        verbs: [get, watch, list]
      - apiGroups: [""]
        resources: [secrets]
        verbs: [get, watch, list]
      - apiGroups: ["", extensions, apps, batch]
        resources: [pods, replicasets, replicationcontrollers, statefulsets, deployments, daemonsets, jobs, cronjobs]
        verbs: [get, delete, watch, list, update]
podSecurityContext:
  # The image runs as uid 666; enforce it and the default seccomp profile.
  runAsNonRoot: true
  seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}
containerSecurityContext:
  # Root filesystem stays writable: keel.db lives in /data.
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}
persistence:
  # keel.db holds approvals and the audit log; neither is used here.
  enabled: false

releases.manifests:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: keel-webhook
  namespace: keel
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels: {app: keel}
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels: {kubernetes.io/metadata.name: builder-system}
        - podSelector: {}
      ports:
        - {port: 9300, protocol: TCP}
releases.name: webhook-policy

security.summary: ClusterRole: reads, lists and watches every Secret (registry credentials of tracked workloads), Namespace and Node; reads, updates and deletes Pods, ReplicaSets, ReplicationControllers, Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs and CronJobs in every namespace.

smoke.manifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: smoke
  namespace: catalog-smoke
  annotations: {keel.sh/policy: force}
spec:
  selector: {matchLabels: {app: smoke}}
  template:
    metadata: {labels: {app: smoke}}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: pause
          image: registry.k8s.io/pause:3.9
---
# Retries until Keel has seen the Deployment; a repeated event is a no-op.
# In Keel's namespace: the NetworkPolicy refuses catalog-smoke.
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: {name: webhook, namespace: keel}
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: curl
          image: curlimages/curl:8.23.0@sha256:3fb7e13e5d179a845c97d78204f3f1064d1907037f26a3ebf91710571151fd93
          command: [sh, -c]
          args:
            - for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do curl -sSf -d '{"name":"registry.k8s.io/pause","tag":"3.10"}' http://keel.keel.svc:9300/v1/webhooks/native; sleep 10; done
smoke.name: rolls-on-native-webhook
